items.html: And we shall explain the matter of the straps in the aspect of the Mochin. For until now we have explained them in the aspect of the Netzah and Hod of Ima, which are the garments of the Mochin. Now we shall speak in the aspect of the Mochin. Behold, from the knot of the head Tefillin, which is the letter Dalet as mentioned, two straps are drawn: one opposite the right and one opposite the left. And in the right strap there is the aspect of Hochma and Hesed of ZA, and in the left one, Gevura and Bina of ZA, which are in the four Mochin. And so they are two straps including the four Mochin, in the order mentioned.
